name: Kyodo
tagline: Shinjuku in 18 minutes and Shibuya in 20 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Odakyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 36 minutes to Otemachi, 18 minutes to Shinjuku, 20 minutes to Shibuya and 46 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 38.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.4 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 38.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 35.2 m to 40.6 m, a difference of 5.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 17 clinics and 13 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 児玉新生会児玉経堂病院, about 3 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 菊池外科病院, about 7 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Odakyu Odawara Line.
congestion: Odakyu Odawara Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 世田谷代田→下北沢, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Miyanosaka is ahead on quiet, but Kyodo is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kyodo. It takes 7 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Kyodo.

neighbours.lead: Gotokuji is ahead on the number of lines, but Kyodo is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Kyodo in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Kyodo.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 12 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Odakyu Odawara Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
